svg.aria-label: Autonomous AI agents: Agents that work on their own, inside real tools, and report back to the team. Support desk, Site and server watch, Telegram assistant, MCP servers, Agent skills, Scheduled jobs. FORMAJES: Training platform for the Ministère des Sports, designed and built from scratch, no AI involved. Multi-role access, Validation workflow, DSFR interface, Exports and reports. MadBullDog: Video production pipeline and AI content tools we build and run together. Derush board, Transcription, Scripts, AI voice-over, Subtitles, Promo videos. Business apps: Custom tools shaped around how each company actually works. CRMs, Quotes and e-signature, Billing exports, Mail sync, Helpdesks, Dashboards. Websites and e-commerce: Sites and shops built, hosted, secured and watched around the clock. WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Memberships, 100+ sites monitored, Security fixes. Native and mobile apps: Mac, Windows and mobile apps that feel at home on each platform. P2P file transfer, AI assistant app, Booking apps, Auto-updates.
